meta.name: Hon Dansade En Sommar (One Summer of Happiness)
meta.description:
One Summer of Happiness (Swedish: Hon dansade en sommar) is a 1951 Swedish film based on the novel Sommardansen by Per Olof Ekstrom. It tells the story of teenage lovers who meet on a farm [Wikipedia]

http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0043652/
